answer: Picture trust as water released from a seeded terrace of verified agents, flowing only along paid interaction edges, each capped at 1 unit per epoch. A sybil swarm, however large, sits behind a narrow jetty: it can receive no more trust than the edges honest agents grant it. With 20 attack edges the attacker gets at most 20 units whether it spawns 10 fakes or 10,000, so each fake's share erodes like a dune. Buying edges at ~500 POA each prices 1,000 units of influence at ~500k POA.
